description: [Meta · free] List available smart-segment templates. Pass a template id to create_segment to pre-fill its `config` predicate without crafting one from scratch. Each template's description states exactly what its config matches; like every smart segment, it only matches people connected to you (engagers on your visible posts and people in your campaigns). Free — costs 0 credits.
